text:
Maria K.: Heads-up: I'm doing a concision pass on the Dedicated Capacity guide to make it more step-by-step. Small PR incoming. Key goals: clarify autoscale policy examples, tighten SLA wording, and remove a couple of stale links. Any must-keep content?
Devon R.: +1. Please include the Terraform quickstart snippet — last time the var names were wrong. Also separate isolation examples into 'tenant' vs 'reserved-pool'.
Sam L.: @Maria K. can you also update the autoscale cooldown examples? PR #6123 flagged preemption interaction in the notes.
Alice Z.: :thumbsup: I'll take a pass on SLA phrasing — want to avoid asserting latency percentiles we don't actually guarantee.
Maria K.: Good call. Proposal: replace the hard claim "99th percentile latency under 200ms" with a neutral line like "target latency band; see SLA table" and link to the SLA page. But the current handbook link seems flaky.
docs-bot: link-check: found redirect /handbook/dedicated/sla -> 404. Files mentioning that path: handbook/dedicated/index.md.
Aaron M.: I can do a quick link surgery. The canonical page moved to /handbook/dedicated/sla-and-slos — I'll open a tiny PR to update the path in index.md.
Maria K.: I'll point the guide to /handbook/dedicated/sla-and-slos for now and add a TODO comment to remove the intermediate redirect once Aaron's PR lands.
Devon R.: For SDK snippets: terraform var should be `redwood_reserved_pool_size` (not `reserved_capacity`). Python example should show `client.create_dedicated_capacity(...)` with `scale_policy='autoscale'` and `isolation='tenant'`.
Maria K.: Adding both — putting example values so folks can copy/paste. Drafting snippets now:
```terraform
resource "redwood_dedicated_capacity" "example" {
  name                    = "prod-reserved"
  gpu_type                = "a100"
  redwood_reserved_pool_size = 3
  scale_policy            = "autoscale"
}
```
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
client.create_dedicated_capacity(
    name="prod-reserved",
    gpu_type="a100",
    replicas=3,
    scale_policy='autoscale',
    isolation='tenant'
)
```
Alice Z.: Nit: include explicit example values in the Terraform snippet (gpu_type and replicas) so it's immediately runnable. Also add a one-line note about quota checks before provisioning.
Maria K.: Will add both. Also planning a tiny migration checklist at the top: pre-migration smoke tests, API key rotation, canary traffic to a single region, rollback checklist.
Sam L.: When you open the PR, tag #eng-runtime and #docs-review. Also mention the earlier autoscale preemption note so impl folks can confirm behaviour.
Maria K.: Will do. Opening draft now and will ping reviewers.
docs-bot: PR created (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9876 (Maria K.)
Devon R.: Thanks — LGTM for the examples; I'll do a detailed review once it's out of draft.
Alice Z.: :eyes: will follow up on SLA wording after Devon's review.
Aaron M.: Link PR opened, should land shortly. If anyone sees other broken handbook links, drop them here and I'll sweep.
Maria K.: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post a short changelog in the PR description and mark the small TODOs so we can follow up post-merge.
